rows.where: landing hero title; README title line
rows.en: Folders are functions.
rows.zh: 資料夾，就是函數。

rows.en: An operating system for agents, built on any resource.
rows.zh: 給 agent 的作業系統，不靠硬體，靠任意資源。

candidates.zh: agent 做的每件事，都是你 ls 得到的檔案。
candidates.en: Everything your agent does is a file you can ls.

candidates.zh: 傳統 OS 把硬體變成檔案；aos 把模型、工具與 agent 變成資料夾。
candidates.en: Where Unix turns hardware into files, aos turns models, tools, and agents into folders.

rows.en: Unix philosophy for the age of agents.
rows.zh: 把 unix 哲學帶進 agent 時代。

rows.where: one-line pitch (landing under hero; README line 2)
rows.en: aos runs AI agents as ordinary Linux processes inside folders. Every tool, every agent, every message is a folder or file you can ls, read, and set permissions on.
rows.zh: aos 把 AI agent 當成一般的 Linux 行程，住在資料夾裡。每個工具、每隻 agent、每封信，都是你可以 ls、可以讀、可以設權限的資料夾或檔案。

rows.en: prototype · demo release
rows.zh: 原型 · demo 版

rows.en: Folder = function. Put an _entry in a folder and it can be called; its notes and data sit right next to it.
rows.zh: 資料夾＝函數。資料夾裡放一個 _entry 就能被呼叫，說明和資料就放在旁邊。

rows.en: Native to LLMs. Models already know how to read and write files and folders; there is no framework to learn.
rows.zh: 模型本來就懂。模型天生會讀寫檔案與資料夾，不用另學一套框架。
rows.note: design claim, not a measurement: never write 'more accurate' or 'faster'

candidates.zh: 模型本來就會。讀檔、寫檔、列資料夾是模型最熟的動作，aos 就拿這些當介面。
candidates.en: Models already know how. Reading, writing and listing files is what they do best, so that is the interface.

rows.en: Rides on Linux. Permissions are file permissions; write tools in any language.
rows.zh: 站在 Linux 上。權限就是檔案權限；工具用什麼語言寫都行。
rows.note: any-language tools: built; permission isolation: experimental (L3)

candidates.zh: 站在 Linux 上。agent 就是一般行程，工具用什麼語言寫都行；權限與環境直接走 Linux 原生機制。
candidates.en: Rides on Linux. Agents are normal processes and tools can be written in any language, using native Linux mechanisms.

rows.en: Small parts, Unix style. A few small programs that each do one thing: exec, loop, daemon.
rows.zh: 小零件，unix 風格。幾支各做一件事的小程式：exec、loop、daemon。

rows.en: Bring your own brain and body. A fake brain for trying, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or your own Claude Code as an agent in the tree.
rows.zh: 腦和身都自己帶。先用假腦試、接任何 OpenAI 相容端點，或把你的 Claude Code 掛進樹裡當一隻 agent。
rows.note: round 2: L2 (Claude Code as an agent) is not run yet (review 3-3); candidates below are reviewer rewrites, not the user's words

candidates.zh: 腦自己帶。先用假腦試，再換成任何 OpenAI 相容端點。
candidates.en: Bring your own brain. Start with a fake one, then point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

candidates.zh: 腦和身都自己帶。先用內建假腦免金鑰試跑，之後可換接 OpenAI 相容端點，或掛入外部 CLI agent（如 Claude Code，實驗中）。

rows.en: A kernel is a door. Starting a process or asking a model is a letter; the door can queue it, budget it, or say no.
rows.zh: kernel 是一扇門。起行程、問模型都是寄一封信；門可以排隊、算預算、說不。
rows.note: only what exists: queue, budget, refuse

rows.en: exec runs one step, loop repeats it, daemon keeps many running. A kernel is the door every request goes through.
rows.zh: exec 跑一步，loop 反覆跑，daemon 讓很多個一直跑。kernel 是每個請求都要經過的門。

rows.en: Step by step, replace the agent with plain code, until token use goes toward zero.
rows.zh: 一步一步把 agent 換成確定的程式，token 用量往零走。

rows.en: Start with an agent. End with a program.
rows.zh: 從一隻 agent 開始，最後換成一支程式。

rows.en: Functions that improve themselves: first, a function that helps you write functions.
rows.zh: 會改進自己的函數：先做一個幫你寫函數的函數。

candidates.zh: 會改進自己的函數：先做一個「幫你寫函數」的母函數。

rows.en: See the whole tree like a company: departments, staff, status.
rows.zh: 像看公司一樣看全景：部門、員工、狀態。
rows.note: in progress; upgrade to a feature card when a screenshot can be shown

rows.en: What you can do today
rows.zh: 今天 clone 下來就能做的

rows.en: aos is a prototype. File formats and commands still change. Linux only (WSL2 works). One tree lives on one machine; trees do not talk to each other yet.
rows.zh: aos 還是原型：檔案格式和指令還會變。只支援 Linux（WSL2 可以）。一棵樹住一台機器；樹和樹之間現在還不會互相連線。

rows.en: Agents run programs under your user account: whatever your account can touch, they can touch. Try aos in a throwaway account, a VM, or a container; a separate folder is not isolation. Sandboxing is experimental.
rows.zh: agent 會用你的帳號執行程式：你的帳號碰得到的檔案，它都碰得到。請在拋棄式帳號、虛擬機或容器裡試；換一個資料夾並不能隔離。沙箱是實驗功能。
rows.zh_v2: agent 會用你的帳號執行程式。請在拋棄式帳號、容器，或丟了也不心疼的資料夾裡試。沙箱是實驗功能。
rows.en_v2: Agents run programs under your user account. Try aos in a throwaway account, container, or folder you do not mind losing. Sandboxing is experimental.
rows.note: round 3: test-1 T1#3 - the old "folder you do not mind losing" read as if a folder isolates; team sentence (source new), changed by lead

rows.en: Try it without any model
rows.zh: 不用任何模型，先試試
rows.note: no minute count until a clean build is timed

rows.en: aos — akatosh operating system
rows.zh: aos：akatosh operating system

rows.where: status block (only if user says yes to ★3 side question)
rows.en: aos is being built by its own team of agents; the working notes are in the repo.
rows.zh: aos 是由它自己的 agent 團隊一起做出來的，工作紀錄都在 repo 裡。
